limits: Six new environment/sampling seeds and new physical instances; one retained trained founder, not six independent training replicates.

Familiar token combinations only; literal first-phrase naming is separate from timely physical grounding and silence.
Natural preparation and cooldown retained; no forced evaluation action or fabricated transition/reward.
No real SLM request, Luna 401 retry, source-state mutation, live/default-brain change or promotion.
No training or objective selection after seeing these actor outcomes. Fixture physical feasibility tests used the public untrained profile and scripted native actions outside scored assessment.
First emitted Declare matches measure literal cue naming, not completed-event success, comprehension or reliable command following.
Natural pre-cue speech can carry cooldown into trials; no cooldown clearing or forced utterance is used.
Frozen actor foundation/Adam state does not disable ordinary native within-life private-state evolution or biological plasticity.
Pre/post cue trials clone the same prepared parent; the post parent sleeps before commands rather than continuing a completed pre-sleep command life.
The cold next-Adam diagnostic applies the saved real gradient to a disposable copy; it does not recompute a new gradient or change the frozen source actor.
